author: SickProdigy
description: Connect Discord to AzerothCore through ac-api-v1, with optional SOAP compatibility for server console information.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores guild settings and reads configured public character statistics. Private API credentials are kept in Red shared API tokens and are never included in Discord output.
install_msg: Configure the private ac-api-v1 base URL and scoped bearer tokens under the azerothcore_api shared-token namespace documented in the cog README. Run [p]azerothcore apicheck before using player or leaderboard commands. SOAP remains optional for compatible server-console features.
name: AzerothCore
short: AzerothCore private API and optional SOAP tools
